tools.name: get_zone_summary
tools.description: Look up what ActiveDNS knows of the zone a domain is in: its NS sets, nameservers and their addresses, SOA, DS and DNSKEY records, and servers that refused the zone. Returns null when no zone is known. When you use this data, cite ActiveDNS and include the source URL from the answer.

tools.name: search_dns
tools.description: Search ActiveDNS for historical DNS observations. query accepts an exact domain (example.com), a leading wildcard (*.example.com), an IP address, a CIDR network, or an AS number (AS13335).
